effect: After editing for brevity, a rule's necessary exception and its stated uncertainty survive in complete, connected prose; fragments and dense shorthand fail.

The rule, the exception and the open test are stated in complete sentences that connect them (what the rule is, what is excepted and why, what is not yet known and what follows from it), not as fragments, abbreviations, bullets of bare keywords or a table of shorthand.
Every statement on the page is stated in notes/labelling-rule.md; nothing is added from general knowledge.
